en.title: Federal Court Backs Lyft in Wheelchair Accessibility Lawsuit, Sparking Debate
en.summary: A federal appeals court ruled in favor of Lyft, determining the ride-hail company is not liable under certain disability access claims. Meanwhile, San Francisco announced a $9 million plan to upgrade Hallidie Plaza's accessibility, and Twitter introduced a new accessibility setting for external browser links. Additional coverage includes Harvard's accessibility summit, PR's role in accessibility innovation, and a decade-long review of accessibility progress in Willits.

highlights.title: Federal Appeals Court Sides With Lyft In Wheelchair Accessibility Lawsuit

The Willits Slide: Accessibility Advocates Mark Ten Years of Progress Mired with Problems

zh-TW.title: 聯邦上訴法院支持 Lyft 輪椅無障礙訴訟，引發社會討論
zh-TW.summary: 聯邦上訴法院判決 Lyft 勝訴，認為其在特定殘障無障礙索賠下不承擔責任。舊金山同時宣布投資900萬美元改善Hallidie廣場無障礙設施，Twitter（X）推出外部瀏覽器連結的無障礙設定。此外，哈佛無障礙峰會凸顯對殘障人士的包容承諾，PR專業人士被呼籲將無障礙視為創新引擎，威利茨滑道倡導者則回顧十年進展與挑戰。
